description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'NormalizableDTO' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField'. It provides mechanisms for normalizing arrays of data, utilizing abstract methods that subclasses are expected to implement for specific behavior. The class includes methods for converting data to arrays, mapping field getter methods, and calling getters on data items.

classes.name: NormalizableDTO
classes.description: An abstract base class providing methods to normalize data into arrays, relying on subclasses to specify how to extract data via getters.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Abstract method to convert data into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a mapping of fields to getter methods.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes iterable data into an array structure based on provided fields, calling getter methods as specified.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Calls getter methods on a data item, supporting nested getters if specified.
